QuestInfo.fullDiz: So, I have a new job for you. Look what I have. This is the knife of those same psychos my boys ran into. During the brawl, they took out a couple of these bastards and found this very knife on one of them. The product, as you can see, is unusual, with strange signs. In short, there is clearly something wrong with these guys, it turns out that serious people are ready to fork out a fortune for such a product. If you happen to find a few more of these knives, bring them to me immediately.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DFuel system isolation - x1|@FF404040- Laser launcher: @FF1D1D1DMaxim - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DLiquid cylinder for Laser launcher - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D50.000 coins

Can you help me find them?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DStrong metal on sale - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DStrong metal - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D14.000 coins

I think you already understood that I support the civilians who remained in the shelters, who unfortunately suffered from the disaster. In fact, all your showdowns are just a means to an end for me. And there is only one end - to help innocent people recover and get back on their feet. After all, I am a doctor, and I took an oath. Therefore, I ask you to get me some morphine, at least a few pieces.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DSilicone tube - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DSet of medicines - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DTablets «Analgin» - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D25.000 coins

Your help is needed for a good cause. You probably already know that I am collecting provisions, medical supplies and other necessary things in order to evacuate people. So almost everything is ready, except for one small detail - we need transport. We have several cars that will fit the entire first batch, but they are not running. They have been idle for too long, and, as I was told, we need batteries and spark plugs. I will make a specific list. Will you deliver?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics on sale - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x2|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x2|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DFirst aid kit «Grizzly» - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D40.000 coins
